assets.prompt: Create a production transparent sprite atlas for RoomCrew's 2.5D office, using the FOUR attached sprite sheets ONLY as character identity and art style references; do not alter their files. New supplemental atlas, exactly 8 columns by 4 rows, 32 separate full-body sprites. Output landscape ideally 2048x1024 so every equal cell is 256x256. No grid lines, labels, text, furniture, desk, monitor, chair, background, shadows outside feet, or other objects. Actual transparent alpha. Same warm hand painted chibi linework, 2.5-head proportions, clothing, hairstyle, colors and shoes as references. Each sprite centered in its cell, generous empty transparent gutter, consistent head size and ground baseline within row. Row1 is green cardigan young male assistant from reference1; row2 pink cardigan short-haired young female employee from reference2; row3 navy blazer blue-haired glasses male guardian from reference3; row4 tan jacket brown-haired male from reference4. ALL columns each row depict that exact same character. Columns1-4: FOUR consecutive loopable typing poses, SEATED, viewed from rear three-quarter angle, facing screen upper-right / northeast. Feet planted lower-right, hips low, knees bent, back of head prominently visible; hands raised forward at desk height, no keyboard drawn, no chair. Tiny alternating finger/forearm movement, body and head scale locked, four poses nearly identical. Column5: same character still seated, halfway turning chair/body toward screen-right side profile; Column6: same seated character now turned three-quarter front toward lower-right/viewer, hands resting on lap, same head size. Column7: rear three-quarter upper-right, halfway rising from seated to standing, bent knees, leaning forward naturally, arms down; Column8: rear three-quarter upper-right fully standing neutrally. All limbs complete, not cut off by cell boundaries. This is sprite production artwork, NO UI mockup or assembled scene. Preserve identity and proportions, no added props. Clear rear typing orientation is mandatory.
